name: Drift example — gaze checked again at the end
notes: Makes gaze drift measurable. The crosses between stimuli and the rest
cross are logged, and validation runs twice: straight after calibration,
and again at the end. server/gaze_drift.py corrects drift from the
crosses and is scored on the LATE block only, which it never sees.
Stimuli last 20 s, which also clears camera heart rate's 10 s window.

disclosure.secondary_use: Analysed by the named research team only. Not sold, and not shared outside the team without a further, separate agreement.
